event: Nala keeps listening as the day goes on: the woman hums, low voices come and go, none deep.
prose: You keep listening. The woman above hums through most of the day, and now and then she talks with someone, light voices, a laugh, footsteps going off. The deep one doesn't come back.

event: She sleeps and wakes several times, listening each time she wakes; the deep voice stays away.
She wakes to the deep voices back beside her, talking low, as they were the morning before.
A heavy hand settles on the belly over her, and the deep voice starts its run again, slow and close.
This time she holds it whole: three sounds, Sa, then vo, then reth, the same each time.
On the next repeat she opens her mouth and works her tongue to make the shape back.
Her mouth opens and closes on it, but no sound comes; only warm fluid where a voice would be.
Her tongue manages Sa and vo; the reth at the end, a curl and a hiss, will not come.
The deep voice stops; the woman above says the three sounds back, softly, stroking the belly.
